column1: # admin-panel/prisma/roles/catalog.tsv — the platform and admin role catalog (WS-75)
# GENERATED SOURCE: this file is the input of scripts/__generate_role_sql.sh, not a record of
# what a database happens to contain. Edit it, then run the generator; never edit the rendered
#   login      yes = the role connects (created LOGIN with PASSWORD NULL; a later secret step
#              sets the credential, so no secret ever enters the repository)
#              no  = the role exists to own objects and is never a connection
#   bypassrls  the catalogued intent, NOT a rendered attribute: the generated file never grants
#              BYPASSRLS (that needs superuser and the running backup path is still cms_backup).
#              Recorded here so the intent is not lost, and so the later step can see the gap.
#   comment    carried into the generated SQL as the reason the role exists
# Role-name contract (validated by the generator; a name outside it is fatal):
#   cms_admin_login                    the pre-session credential read; the one admin role
#                                      without a domain, because it runs before a session exists
#   cms_admin_<capability>_<domain>    capability is read | write | operate | account
# `all:all` is an application permission, never a database role. Contest roles
# (cms_contest_<id>_<mode>_<capability>) are a later slice: they are per-contest credentials and
# do not belong in a static catalog.
